reviews.body:
## Pull request overview

This PR refactors the `persistent_shell` module by extracting inline test blocks (`mod tests { ... }`) from `session.rs` and `manager.rs` into dedicated test files under a new `tests/` subdirectory. The `shells` field on `PersistentShellManager` was made `pub(crate)` to compensate for the loss of `super::*` access from inline test modules.

**Changes:**
- Extracted session tests from `session.rs` into `tests/session_tests.rs` and manager tests from `manager.rs` into `tests/manager_tests.rs`, with a new `tests/mod.rs` to declare submodules.
- Changed `PersistentShellManager.shells` visibility from private to `pub(crate)` to allow test access from the external test module.
- Added a new entry to `.jules/fractal.md` documenting the refactoring.

### Reviewed changes

Copilot reviewed 7 out of 7 changed files in this pull request and generated 5 comments.
